question: Where is the closest attraction located toward the north of Red Wolf Sanctuary, Rising Sun, IN?
sql: WITH sanctuary_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rising Sun%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ), sanctuary_id AS ( SELECT id FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rising Sun%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, sanctuary_location AS sl WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND p.id != (SELECT id FROM sanctuary_id) -- Exclude the sanctuary itself AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 100000) -- Search within 100km for performance AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
